_instructions: Convert the draft below into this JSON. REQUIRED: retain 80–90% of the source wording in sections[] — Bible studies must not be over-summarised. Keep section headings, scripture quotes, lists, and teaching points from the source. REQUIRED: always set includeQuiz to true and write 3–5 quiz questions from the study content. Vary correctIndex — do not put every correct answer as option A (index 0). For each quiz question: one correct answer and three plausible wrong answers. Set correctIndex to the 0-based index of the correct option after ordering options. REQUIRED: fill tags from _allowedTags. Do not include date, hero image, featured, or published.
